title: From discovery to first approved medicine
subtitle: Years from the key scientific discovery (open circle) to the first U.S. approval built on it (filled).

items.label: Antisense oligonucleotides
items.detail: 1978: Zamecnik & Stephenson block a virus with a synthetic antisense oligo. 1998: fomivirsen approved.

items.label: RNA interference (siRNA)
items.detail: 1998: Fire, Mello et al. describe RNAi. 2018: patisiran approved.

items.label: Modified-nucleoside mRNA
items.detail: 2005: Karikó, Weissman et al. show modified nucleosides evade innate immunity. December 2020: COVID-19 mRNA vaccines authorized.

items.label: CRISPR guide-RNA editing
items.detail: 2012: Jinek et al. program Cas9 with a guide RNA. December 2023: exa-cel (Casgevy) approved.
